post.originalText:
gemini 4 argon is f*cking insane

same prompt, one scene: a train pulling out of a station on some alien planet

opus 5.5: 1h 53m, $23.46
gemini 4 argon: 4m 20s, $3.40

26x faster. 7x cheaper. shorter than making a coffee

and it still landed the whole shot, the station, the planets, the lightning off in the distance, the train actually leaving

this is the part that breaks my brain. a model this fast and this cheap has no business looking this good

watch it and tell me argon isn't the most slept-on model right now
